title: The impact of colloid-solvent dynamic coupling on the coarsening rate of colloidal phase separation.
authors: Tateno, Michio; Yuan, Jiaxing; Tanaka, Hajime
journal: Journal of colloid and interface science
one_liner_zh: 该文用粒子模拟研究胶体相分离粗化动力学中胶体-溶剂动态耦合的物理机制，对象为胶体而非无序蛋白/IDR，且无PPI或AI/物理建模方法针对互作机制，仅对相分离动力学有间接启发。
abstract: Phase separation, a fundamental phenomenon in both natural and industrial settings, involves the coarsening of domains over time t to reduce interfacial energy. While well-understood for simple viscous liquid mixtures, the physical laws governing coarsening dynamics in complex fluids, such as colloidal suspensions, remain unclear. Here, we investigate colloidal phase separation through particle-based simulations with and without hydrodynamic interactions (HIs). The former incorporates many-body HIs through momentum conservation, while the latter simplifies their effects into a constant friction coefficient on a particle. In cluster-forming phase separation with HIs, the domain size l grows as l proportional, variantt(1/3), aligning with the Brownian-coagulation mechanism. Without HIs, l proportional, variantt(1/5), attributed to an improper calculation of cluster thermal diffusion. For network-forming phase separation, l proportional, variantt(1/2) with HIs, while l proportional, variantt(1/3) without HIs. In both cases, network coarsening is governed by the mechanical stress relaxation of the colloid-rich phase, yet with distinct mechanisms: slow solvent permeation through densely packed colloids for the former and free draining for the latter. Our results provide a clear and concise physical picture of colloid-solvent dynamic coupling via momentum conservation, offering valuable insights into the self-organization dynamics of particles like colloids, emulsions, and globular proteins suspended in a fluid.
abstract_zh: 相分离（phase separation）是自然和工业环境中的基本现象，涉及域随时间t粗化以降低界面能。尽管对于简单粘性液体混合物这一过程已被充分理解，但在复杂流体（如胶体悬浮液）中控制粗化动力学的物理规律仍不清楚。在此，我们通过基于粒子的模拟，分别在有和没有流体动力学相互作用（HIs）的情况下研究胶体相分离。前者通过动量守恒纳入多体HIs，而后者将其效应简化为粒子上的恒定摩擦系数。在含HIs的簇形成相分离中，域尺寸l按l∝t^(1/3)增长，与布朗凝聚机制一致。无HIs时，l∝t^(1/5)，归因于簇热扩散计算不当。对于网络形成相分离，含HIs时l∝t^(1/2)，而无HIs时l∝t^(1/3)。在两种情况下，网络粗化均由富胶体相的机械应力松弛控制，但机制不同：前者通过致密堆积胶体中的缓慢溶剂渗透，后者则通过自由排水。我们的结果通过动量守恒提供了胶体-溶剂动态耦合的清晰简明物理图景，为悬浮在流体中的胶体、乳液和球状蛋白等粒子的自组织动力学提供了宝贵见解。
